name: Driftclean Pressed Occasion Dress — Shelf Cut
description:
A knee-length dress in a deep navy synth-polyester that photographs darker than it looks in person, which is a feature the vendor actively advertises. The fabric is thin enough to fold into a pocket-sized square, which matters when storage space is limited. The cut is universally generous — a single size-adjustable drawstring at the waist allows it to fit a wide range of bodies, including those with minor geneware modifications. A small tail accommodation slit has been roughly cut into the back seam on some units and left raw-edged, a field modification that has become so common the vendor now includes it as an option at point of sale.

This dress exists because people on the Shelf have occasions too. It is sold in market stalls alongside cleaning supplies and ration supplements, and it is priced to be reachable on a single shift's pay. The fabric pills after three washes but holds its color. It is not beautiful in any technical sense. It is appropriate, and on the Shelf, appropriate is enough.
cultural_context: Widely recognized as Shelf-formal by anyone who grew up below Tier 3. In Tier 2 spaces it passes without comment. In Tier 3 and above it reads immediately as out-of-place, which can be either a source of shame or defiant identity depending on the wearer.
story_hooks: A synthetic personhood hearing requires formal attire. A synthetic being with no personal income is given this dress by a Shelf neighbor who wanted them to feel dignified walking in.
The dress is available in only three colors — navy, black, and a dark green. A character needs to attend two different events in the same week and can only afford one.
Someone has worn this dress to every important moment in their life for fifteen years. The drawstring has been replaced four times. The fabric is worn thin at the shoulders.

physical_description.visual_profile: A knee-length shift dress with a humble, utilitarian silhouette. Deep navy that photographs nearly black but reveals itself as midnight blue in direct light. The fabric drapes simply without structure, creating a straight, unfussy line from shoulder to hem. The overall impression is modest, practical, and deliberately unpretentious—clothing that exists to be worn, not admired.
physical_description.fit: Universally generous and forgiving. Single drawstring waist cinches to adjust across a wide range of body types and augmentation profiles, including minor subcutaneous or external mods. Sleeves are simple and unfit—neither fitted nor intentionally loose, just present. The cut accommodates tail modifications via a rough-edged slit at the back seam.
physical_description.primary_material: Thin synth-polyester, lightweight enough to fold into a pocket-sized square for storage. Budget-conscious composition designed for portability in space-constrained living quarters.
physical_description.texture: Smooth to the touch with a slight sheen that dulls with wear. Pills noticeably after three washes, creating soft fuzz across the surface—a known limitation that owners accept. Raw edges where the tail slit has been cut, either factory-applied or field-modified.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep navy with a photographic quality darker than its true tone—a selling point marketed by vendors. No pattern, no accent colors. Pure, unadorned blue-black.
physical_description.closures: Single drawstring at the waist for size adjustment. No zippers, snaps, or buckles. Designed for simplicity and durability in frequent washing.
distinctive_features: Folds into pocket-sized square for storage efficiency
Size-adjustable drawstring accommodates wide range of body types
Tail accommodation slit with raw edges (factory option or field modification)
Fabric pills visibly after three washes but holds color
Sold in market stalls alongside cleaning supplies and ration supplements
Price point: single shift's pay on the Shelf
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 accessibility despite being worn primarily by Shelf workers. Functions as a bridge garment—appropriate enough for formal occasions in lower tiers, immediately readable as out-of-place in Tier 3 and above.
physical_description.cultural_context: Shelf-formal wear. Signifies both acceptance of practical limitations and presence at occasions that matter within sub-tier communities. Wearing it to Tier 3+ spaces reads as either shameful displacement or defiant identity depending on the wearer's bearing.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and well-washed. Pills are visible across the chest and shoulders. The drawstring shows wear at the knot. The tail slit edges fray slightly with time. Despite wear, the garment maintains its color and structural integrity.

image_prompt: A knee-length navy synth-polyester dress on a dark mannequin or lean cyberpunk model, shot against a moody dimly-lit urban backdrop. The fabric appears almost black in the shadows but reveals deep midnight blue where light hits it. Raw-edged tail slit visible at the back seam. Simple drawstring waist, unstructured sleeves. Slight pilling visible on the surface from repeated washing. Staged in a cramped market stall setting with cleaning supplies and ration boxes in soft focus background. Moody tungsten and neon lighting. Fashion photography, documentary realism, 2226 GLMZ aesthetics. --ar 2:3 --v 6
